summary: Iteration 4: Full backend + frontend testing of pass-window validation, digital pass views, admin check-in, confirmation modal (view-pass + WhatsApp), and admin table Ticket column. 18/18 backend pytest cases passed. All frontend flows exercised via Playwright passed: landing regression, anon /admin gate, /pass/{token} guest ticket + no gate-panel, invalid token -> pass-not-found, admin cookie shows gate-panel + check-in works (twice -> unavailable), /admin bookings table shows open-pass + send-pass with correct wa.me/91<phone> href + checked-in tag, full guest booking flow (Silver = Early Bird 1299) -> confirmation-modal with booking-reference, view-pass-button navigating to ticket, confirmation-whatsapp-button href containing wa.me/917065319679 and booking id.
critical_code_review_comments: PassPage.jsx uses 'amount' in pass && pass.amount !== 0 to detect admin view — brittle. If a legitimate amount is 0 for a comp ticket, gate-panel would hide. Consider explicit can_check_in-like admin flag from server (e.g., include is_admin_view boolean in PassView).
validate_pass_selection date windows are hard-coded to EVENT_YEAR=2026 with month/day tuples; if event dates shift, changes must happen in code. Consider moving to settings collection.
check_in_pass returns view_pass which re-queries booking — minor extra DB round-trip; acceptable.
BookingModal error handling only stringifies detail; 422 validation errors (list) fall back to generic message. Fine for now.
PassPage isAdmin heuristic will show gate-panel for guest if server accidentally leaks amount>0 to public — defence-in-depth: server already blanks fields, so ok.
